offline:webAppDescription: Install SuttaCentral.net as an app and keep the texts you choose for reading offline. Needs JavaScript and an up to date browser, and can be unreliable to install.
offline:editionsDescription: Whole books of translations, as ePub, PDF or HTML files, or in print.
offline:siteArchiveDescription: The whole site as plain HTML files to download, which work on any computer or smartphone with a local web server.
offline:nativeAppsDescription: The whole site as an app to install on macOS, Windows, Linux or Android, which opens like any other.
offline:kiwixZimDescription: The whole site as one file for {kiwix}, the free offline reader for phones, tablets and computers.
